# Healthcare Utilization

This folder covers the metrics and patterns of patient interactions with the Danish healthcare system for chronic gastrointestinal and hepatobiliary diseases. It details the frequency of hospital contacts and the proportion of physical versus virtual visits, providing a quantitative view of the clinical burden and resource requirements for managing conditions like IBD and PSC across both pediatric and adult populations.

## Pages

- [[healthcare-utilization|Healthcare Utilization]] — Tracks the average number of hospital contacts and the ratio of in-person versus virtual visits for newly diagnosed and prevalent pediatric and adult patients with IBD and PSC.
